podcast.title: Kraftwerk's Influence
podcast.body: Chillout music, alongside ambient genres, bears the distinct influence of Kraftwerk, demonstrating the German band's far-reaching impact on the creation of atmospheric electronic sounds. "Today's EDM and all techno from groups like Underworld and anything that came out of Detroit to Daff Punk, Ambient and Chillout music, Craftwork influence."
